'''2006 World Championship''' was a Players Committee constructed World Championship, held in Chicago, Illinois.<ref name="awards">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/community/awards/ Awards and Hall of Fame], starwarsccg.org; Wayback [https://web.archive.org/web/20230817222457/https://www.starwarsccg.org/community/awards/ 17 August 2023]</ref> [[Nate Meeker]] defeated [[Brian Hunter]].<ref name="awards" />

The constructed pool was printed Decipher cards through [[Theed Palace]] plus original [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Players Committee Virtual Sets]] then legal. A numbered original-VS cutoff for this event is not dested here.

Published 60s from this event are not on this wiki yet.

== Format ==

* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]] (probably; the event was moved from its planned August 2006 date and the new date was not found; Virtual Sets 7–11 became legal on 4 December 2006)<ref name="pc-jun06">[http://www.swccgpc.com/ SWCCGPC.com] (home page; news item "World's Date Change - Your Vote Matters", admin_mike, 16 June 2006: "PasTimes in Chicago is working with us in order to provide a new date. August date conflicted with other pre-planned events."). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060617215932/http://www.swccgpc.com/ Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''Dates:''' 2006
* '''Site:''' Chicago, Illinois
* '''Winner:''' [[Nate Meeker]]
* '''Runner-up:''' [[Brian Hunter]]
